tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt. This sits alongside the recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so every connection is made over HTTPS and its certificate is verified.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
